label: PF Backlog 448
title: WorkerGrid Stage 3b: pluggable store (SQLite default + PostgreSQL multi-node) + atomic claim
body:
Source: pre-implementation IMPACT review 2026-10-07 (user-approved: "Approve the 3b slice").
Authorities: docs/WORKERGRID-DESIGN.md section 5 (SQLite single-node -> PostgreSQL for multi-node) + section 6
(deployment single-node vs multi-node); ADR-0002 (WorkerGrid owns coordination state); Go-first rule.

Goal: make the coordinator store pluggable - SQLite (default, single-node, back-compat) OR PostgreSQL
(multi-node, multiple coordinator processes sharing one store) - without a second coordinator, HTTP API, or
store. Multi-process claim safety replaces the current read-then-write-under-in-process-mutex path.

IMPACT review verdicts (approved): (6) the current claim is read-then-write under an in-process mutex
(correct only for one process) -> gap for multi-node; make claim a SINGLE atomic statement
(INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(item_id) DO UPDATE SET ... WHERE leases.expires_at < now RETURNING worker_id) shared
by both dialects, keeping the contract suite green. (7) lease expiry uses node wall-clock -> documented
clock-sync requirement; DB-time variant deferred. All other claims aligned (design sections 5/6, ADR-0002
single writer, one store, Go-first, no store-registry impact since WG state is external).

In scope: (1) internal/store: dialect field + rebind (?)->($n); schema per dialect; OpenDSN(driver, dsn, ttl)
with Open(stateDir, ttl) kept as the SQLite default; atomic claim statement; Postgres uses a connection pool
+ startup Ping (fail-closed). (2) config: `store` block {driver: sqlite|postgres, dsn} + env
WORKERGRID_STORE_DRIVER / WORKERGRID_STORE_DSN; default sqlite state/workergrid.db (back-compat).
(3) driver: pure-Go github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib (no CGO). (4) tests: Go unit tests for rebind/dialect;
env-gated PostgreSQL e2e (WORKERGRID_PG_DSN) proving the full lease lifecycle + persistence across a
coordinator restart (shared state), skipped without a DSN; contract suite unchanged (SQLite). (5) docs:
design section 15 + sections 5/6, README, config _doc, ops doc config table + multi-node note.

Out of scope: schema migrations engine (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS only, as today), DB-time leases,
connection failover/pooling tuning, HA/leader election.

Related (different concern): BI-PF-0402 [Epic B] persistence adapters (SQLite/JSON/PostgreSQL) - PF-side
data stores, not the WorkerGrid coordination store.

dashboard_impact: needs_dashboard=false - WorkerGrid coordinator is an external execution-plane component;
operator surface is the /wg command + coordinator API (same rationale as BI-PF-0412/0413).

delivery.note: merged --no-ff; precheck --full green (39 gates, 842 passed, 3 skipped); wg-go gate green (gofmt+build+vet+go test+contract parity+agent e2e+pg e2e gated); pg e2e self-skips without WORKERGRID_PG_DSN and proves two coordinators share one PostgreSQL store

decisions.decision: Stage 3b approved: pluggable store (SQLite default + PostgreSQL), single atomic claim statement for multi-process safety (claim 6), documented clock-skew limitation (claim 7), pgx pure-Go driver, env-gated PG e2e, docs + gates in the slice

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/artifact_store.py, core/asset_store.py, core/forge_store.py, core/pipeline_store.py

_note: Stage 3b delivered: pluggable store (SQLite default + PostgreSQL multi-node) + atomic claim
